recognize_zh: 中央兩顆細胞質藍色、核偏心的漿細胞內，可見大量細長、交錯排列的紫紅色針狀包涵體，形似 Auer rods；周圍其他是正常的嗜中性球系與嗜伊紅性細胞，說明這些桿狀物位於漿細胞，是骨髓瘤的假 Auer 桿。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm
Numerous thin, needle-shaped azurophilic rod-like inclusions criss-crossing within the cytoplasm
One plasma cell packed with dense rods overlying the nucleus; another with a looser bundle beside the nucleus
Adjacent plasma cell without inclusions, plus maturing neutrophils, a myelocyte, eosinophil and small lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm among maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil and lymphocytes. Two plasma cells contain numerous slender, needle-like azurophilic crystalline inclusions arranged in overlapping criss-cross bundles, resembling Auer rods. The surrounding myeloid cells show normal maturation without such inclusions. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with intracytoplasmic pseudo-Auer rods.

ddx.vs: Faggot cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and MPO-positive rods, whereas these rods are in mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei.
Auer rods are usually single in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, not multiple crystals in plasma cells.
Crystals in histiocytosis are within macrophages with pale abundant cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain round globular immunoglobulin inclusions rather than needle-shaped crystalline rods.
